## Checklist

- [ ] One topic, and the title follows the commit message format

- [ ] Features that exist on both platforms behave the same on iOS and the web
- [ ] Older app versions keep working with the API (see Branches and releases in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or personal data
